title: Build Targets
description: List of platform/architecture combinations to produce release binaries for.

vendor.description: Vendor component of the target triple (e.g. apple, unknown).

abi.description: Optional ABI suffix (e.g. gnu, musl). Omit for platforms that don't use one.

archs.description: CPU architectures to build for this platform (e.g. x86_64, aarch64).
